csc.help.title: Clientside Chat — Commands Overview
csc.help.host: /csc host [password] [max_players] [hours] — Host a server & generate Session Token
csc.help.join: /csc join <token> — Join anonymously via Session Token (E2EE active)
csc.help.token: /csc token — Show your active Session Token
csc.help.status: /csc status — Show hosting, E2EE & log status
csc.chat.connected: ✔ Connected successfully (AES-256-GCM E2EE)! Type #message to chat.
csc.chat.not_connected: Not connected and not hosting! Use /csc host or /csc join <token>
csc.chat.host_started: ✔ Server started! (AES-256-GCM E2EE, Max. %d players, %dh valid)
